blurb: Sandbar Powersports rents pontoon boats and ski boats for exploring Lake Havasu, including the London Bridge, Copper Canyon, and the Sandbar. Rentals accommodate up to 12 people and include boats with Bluetooth sound systems. The company is locally owned and operated since 2008, with flexible rental options including half-day, full-day, or multi-day.
